implementation.targetScope: Desktop FuseScrollbars contract: constructor, update/destroy, native scroll positions, overflow rails/thumbs, wheel and boundary propagation, keyboard, rail paging, thumb dragging, scroll/reach events and caller CSS hooks. VentiMath disables this widget on touch/mobile devices; touch/swipe inertia and legacy browser geometry are outside scope.

changes: Independent runtime and CSS with zero runtime dependencies; no upstream runtime copied.
Own-document listeners and events, pointer cancellation, idempotent teardown and explicit per-element ownership prevent cross-window and lifecycle leaks.
ResizeObserver and content mutations coalesce automatic updates; explicit update remains available. Geometry keeps fractional positions and bounds oversized thumbs to the viewport.
Focusable scrollbar roles expose axis/range/value and control relationships; editable content and button keyboard behavior remain native. Reduced-motion and forced-colors styles are included.
Invalid settings reject before modifying the host. Destruction restores owned classes/IDs and leaves caller content/styles intact. Touch handlers and swipeEasing reject explicitly.

caller.scope: Desktop custom-scrollbar setting, wheelPropagation and suppressScrollX options, native scrollTop resets, ps-* event subscriptions, ps__rail/ps__thumb CSS and effect cleanup. Real browser checks use this public lifecycle pattern. Release and app adoption are separate.
